items.title: Susan Hiller — Bad Dreams

items.times: Opening reception: October 16, 19:00–22:00; German-language overview tour: October 17, 16:00–17:00. Regular visiting hours not supplied.
items.why_candidate: New Berlin survey exploring personal and collective imaginaries through images, objects, mass media and popular culture. Strong memory-and-archives relevance; opens during the briefing window.

items.title: Alpha Maid + Dylan Kerr & Madeline Stepien
items.why_candidate: Kerr and Stepien combine extended vocal techniques, microtonality, psychoacoustics and live processing. Alpha Maid adds guitar-led music and dub influences explicitly connected to Jamaican heritage and the Windrush Generation.

items.title: Andriy K. & Tharim Cornelisse pres. DUST + mu tate pres. life of mu
items.why_candidate: Experimental electronic and audiovisual programme combining DUST's textural sound and imagery with mu tate's dissolving melodies, shifting rhythms and immersive density. DUST explores presence and sudden disappearance.

items.title: In Companionship of Birds – Die Vogelgefährten
items.why_candidate: Date-verified hybrid participatory workshop combining narration, improvisation, play and conversation around Attar's The Conference of the Birds. Included as a wildcard, not a public performance; €290, in German, English or both.

items.title: Butoh Intensive “Materiality”
items.why_candidate: Date-verified participatory Butoh workshop using material imagery to transform the body rather than mime it. Included as an embodied-practice wildcard, not a public performance. Open to all, taught in English; €200.
